purpose: Teach: 持ち込む/値引き/コツコツ/売店/上層/掛かり/精算/夜勤

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、押収物、絶対、持ち込む、絶対、保管庫、絶対、強化しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We've genuinely strengthened our evidence storage procedures. We really appreciate your patience.
lines.style: Even, professional tone. Steady pacing. Pride in competence without boasting. Brief pause after the first clause. Respectful closure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、値引き、絶対、講習、絶対、地域に、絶対、提供されてありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're truly grateful for the training seminars and community outreach the police have provided.
lines.style: Warm, genuine appreciation. Nod in the voice. Slightly slower on 'truly grateful'—he means it. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、コツコツ、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're steadily moving forward with the investigation. Thank you for your cooperation.
lines.style: Measured, patient. Quiet confidence about methodical work. Small pause before 'thank you'—he's checking that Kenji understands this takes time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、売店、絶対、近くで、絶対、巡回ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. It's really reassuring to see the increased patrols around the neighborhood.
lines.style: Calm relief in the voice. Not over-emphatic, but genuine warmth. Slight lean forward on 'really reassuring.' Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、上層、絶対、部、絶対、決済、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Management has approved moving ahead with the claims settlement. We're on it.
lines.style: Direct, competent. No flourish—just facts. Quiet assurance underneath. Brief, because the work speaks for itself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、掛かり、絶対、官、絶対、ご対応ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're very grateful for how quickly your department has handled everything.
lines.style: Earnest, straightforward. Not overly warm but genuinely appreciative. Even pacing. Respectful weight on 'very grateful.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、被害金の、絶対、精算、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The compensation process is underway. We're committed to resolving this quickly.
lines.style: Calm assurance. Professional but not cold. Slight emphasis on 'quickly'—he's heard the urgency. Stable, reliable tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の、本気で、絶対、夜勤、絶対、巡回、絶対、安心です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We feel much safer knowing there are night patrols. Thank you.
lines.style: Quiet relief. Genuine warmth. Slower on 'much safer'—it matters. Soft, sincere close on the thanks. Almost a breath at the end.
